verdict.rationale: EFTPS's only documented background automation is scheduling a payment up to 365 days ahead, after which funds move on the chosen settlement date without the user present. This is a one-off scheduled action, not a recurring schedule or general automation. There is no API or OpenAPI spec (the probe returned 404), and the only software channel is the Batch Provider program. Missing for 10: recurring or rule-based automations, a programmatic API for setting up automations, triggers or workflow logic beyond single scheduled payments, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Schedule payments up to 365 days in advance.
The funds will move out of your banking account on the date you select for settlement.
